note: Corrections by eleven Opus correction agents, one per review group, applying only the adjudicated decisions 'correct' and 'correct_conservatively' (review/adjudication-gN.json) and validation findings. Per-group logs stay in revised/corrections-gN.json. Records without an accepted correction are byte copies of extracted/. status_change_note: validate_factoid.py takes each record's status from the extraction batch reports. Where a correction turned a record into an abstention or an abstention into factoids, status_after here is the corrected outcome, and the revised validation reports the mismatch.
